Algeria Expedition

Dec 13 → Dec 17, 2026 · Bouira, Algeria

Group: small groupHighlight: Lalla Khedidja summit, 2308 mTransport: comfort taxiStay: chalet in Bouira
  1. Day 0 · Sunday, Dec 1318:00 · Departure
    • Leave Sousse for Bouira by comfort taxi (overnight trip).
  2. Day 1 · Monday, Dec 1407:00 · Arrival in Bouira
    • Transfer to the chalet, rest and drop the gear.
    • Hike to Lake Agoulmim.
    • Back to the chalet for dinner and an evening together.
  3. Day 2 · Tuesday, Dec 15Summit day
    • Preparation and early start.
    • Full-day hike to the summit of Lalla Khedidja (2308 m).
    • Return to the chalet.
  4. Day 3 · Wednesday, Dec 16Forest day
    • Day hike through the forest, exploring Algerian nature.
    • Get ready for the trip back to Tunisia.
  5. Day 4 · Thursday, Dec 1708:00 · Back in Tunisia
    • Arrival in Tunisia.
650 DTAll-inclusive trip

What’s included

  • Round-trip transport Bouira – Tunis
  • Guide for Lalla Khedidja and Lake Agoulmim
  • Forest hike
  • Transport between activities
  • 2 nights in a chalet
  • Food available – included
